title: Validation failed: missing required config key
cause: A config artifact was committed without a mandatory top-level field such as name or version.
fix: Add the missing key to the file, or update required_keys in .devtrack/rules if the rule is wrong.

title: Hash mismatch / corrupted object
cause: A stored object no longer matches its SHA-256 name: disk corruption or a manual edit inside .devtrack/objects.
fix: Run `devtrack verify`, restore the object from a backup or re-add the artifact from a known-good copy.

title: File not found / wrong working directory
cause: The test or tool ran from a different directory than expected, or the artifact path is misspelled.
fix: Use paths relative to the project root and check the CWD in the CI job.

title: Numeric tolerance / assertion mismatch
cause: Output differs from the reference value, often from a changed default, rounding, or an off-by-one in a loop bound.
fix: Diff the inputs between the last passing and first failing version (`devtrack diff`), then check boundary conditions.

title: Segmentation fault in native code
cause: Out-of-bounds access or use of an uninitialised/dangling pointer in C/C++ code.
fix: Rebuild with -g -fsanitize=address,undefined and rerun the failing test to get the exact line.

title: Test timeout / hang
cause: An infinite loop, a blocked subprocess, or a lock that is never released.
fix: Rerun with verbose logging and a lower timeout; check subprocess calls and loop exit conditions.

title: Database locked or schema mismatch
cause: Two processes writing to metadata.db at once, or a store created by an older schema version.
fix: Serialise writes (one writer at a time) and re-initialise or migrate the store.

title: Forbidden secret committed
cause: A credential was hard-coded into an artifact.
fix: Remove the secret, rotate it, and load it from an environment variable instead.
